prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Your Pet's Looks & Personality", "Select traits to customize your companion's appearance and behavior in real time.", "Select Companion Style"]
1: ["Choose Desktop Companion Anchoring", "Select whether your companion roams freely, sits on the taskbar, or stays pinned to top corner.", "Desktop Anchoring Mode", "Confirm Placement"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Account", "Sign in now to lock in your custom pet and enable seamless multi-device desktop syncing."]
3: ["Smart Photo Framing & Lighting Check", "Upload photos with automated alignment feedback for crisp desktop rendering.", "Choose Companion Photo", "Lighting and face position verified"]
4: ["Choose Your Setup Speed", "Pick quick preset adoption or create a custom pet companion.", "Instant vs Custom Path"]
5: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet progress and customizations will be permanently secured to your cloud account.", "Prevents pet resets when launching on new devices or updating the desktop app."]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay & Graphics", "Optimizing screen overlay permissions and transparency buffers for your pet.", "Checking GPU overlay capability"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Use quick shortcuts to interact with or minimize your companion anytime.", "Press Alt+P to summon, or right-click pet tray icon to adjust visibility."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Sign your companion pledge to officially welcome your pet home.", "Official Companion Seal"]
9: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Watch how companions react to your work, play mini-games, and keep you company.", "Start Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency by telling users to sign in now to lock in their custom pet.
Asks for personal information by requiring personal photo uploads and face verification.
